description: Source code implementing LiveKit transport integration for Pipecat, including classes and methods for managing real-time communication, participant events, media streaming, and messaging within a LiveKit room.

classes.name: LiveKitOutputTransportMessageFrame
classes.description: Frame for transport messages in LiveKit rooms, optionally for a specific participant.

classes.name: LiveKitOutputTransportMessageUrgentFrame
classes.description: Urgent transport message frame for LiveKit rooms, optionally for a specific participant.

classes.name: LiveKitTransportMessageFrame
classes.description: Deprecated transport message frame, extends LiveKitOutputTransportMessageFrame with warning.

classes.name: LiveKitTransportMessageUrgentFrame
classes.description: Deprecated urgent transport message frame, extends LiveKitOutputTransportMessageUrgentFrame with warning.

classes.name: LiveKitParams
classes.description: Configuration parameters for LiveKit transport, inherits from TransportParams.

classes.name: LiveKitCallbacks
classes.description: Callback handlers for LiveKit events, including connection, participant, media, and data events.

classes.name: LiveKitTransportClient
classes.description: Core client managing connection, media streaming, participant management, and event handling with LiveKit.

classes.name: LiveKitInputTransport
classes.description: Handles incoming media streams and events from LiveKit, forwarding as Pipecat frames.

classes.name: LiveKitOutputTransport
classes.description: Handles outgoing media streams and messaging to LiveKit room participants.

classes.name: LiveKitTransport
classes.description: Main transport class integrating LiveKit for real-time communication, managing input/output transports and events.

methods.name: participant_id
methods.description: Returns the participant ID assigned by LiveKit.

methods.name: room
methods.description: Returns the LiveKit room instance, raises exception if not initialized.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the client with task manager and room setup.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Cleans up client resources, disconnects from room.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the client, initializes audio components.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Connects to the LiveKit room with retry logic.

methods.name: publish_audio
methods.description: Publishes an audio frame to the room.

methods.name: _write_dtmf_native
methods.description: Uses LiveKit's native method to send DTMF.

methods.name: _convert_pipecat_audio_to_livekit
methods.description: Converts Pipecat audio bytes to LiveKit AudioFrame.

methods.name: send_audio
methods.description: Sends an audio frame via output transport.

methods.name: get_participant_metadata
methods.description: Retrieves metadata for a specific participant.

methods.name: send_message
methods.description: Sends a message to room participants.
